parameters.name: All
parameters.description: Specifies whether to remove all tags from the resources.

parameters.name: ResourceType
parameters.description: The resource type. Set this parameter to INSTANCE.

parameters.name: TagKey
parameters.description:
The key of the tag.
> N specifies the sequence number of the tag key. For example: * Tag.1.Key specifies the key of the first tag. * Tag.2.Key specifies the key of the second tag.
